purpose: Lets a reviewer decide the target type of each review target and select which documents to read per type, defining the judgment procedure and the type-to-document mapping.
summary: Five target types: code, requirement, design, plan, uxui; ADR is treated as design
Type judgment procedure using resolve_doc_structure.py rather than reading the config file directly
Mapping from returned doc_type to target type, including UI-related document detection
Handling of null doc_type: read the file to detect source code
Targets whose type cannot be determined are reviewed with common documents only, without findings or errors
Common documents applied to all types: generic criteria, review priorities, scope proportionality, error classification
Per-type tables of review criteria, built-in norms, project-specific rules, and cross-check targets
Rule not to guess type from file or directory names alone
tasks: Reviewing code, requirements, designs, plans, or UI/UX documents
Determining the target type of a review target
Selecting which criteria and norm documents a reviewer reads
Defining or modifying the reviewer agent behavior
title: レビュー対象の種別と読む文書
